title: External Onboarding Pages - /join Flow
description: Complete onboarding flow for external agents and builders to register via website. Includes landing page with user type selection and dedicated registration forms with plan selection and backend API integration.
features: Landing page with 3 user type cards (Individual Agent, Property Agency, Real Estate Builder)
Animated cards with Framer Motion transitions
Feature comparison per user type (FREE, PRO, PREMIUM plans)
Agent registration form with plan selection (FREE/BASIC/PRO)
Builder registration form with PREMIUM plan display
Success states with redirect to dashboard
acceptance_criteria: Landing page displays 3 user type options with features
Agent form validates and submits to backend
Builder form validates and submits to backend
result_summary: Complete /join onboarding flow implemented with landing page and dedicated registration forms for agents and builders. All forms integrate with existing backend APIs. Success states with dashboard redirects. Full dark mode and responsive design.
